authorization: Explicit 2026-09-18 morphology pilot before manuscript; derived analysis only

constructs.angle_p50: Angular spread, NOT isotropy or semantic diversity
constructs.pr: Effective linear covariance dimension, NOT true intrinsic dimension or count of topics
constructs.gap_25: Weighted-by-degree connectivity of unweighted union-25NN normalized Laplacian, NOT semantic fragmentation

preprocessing: float64 per-row L2; distances in full space; center only for covariance; tie order by sorted global row_index

stability.interpretation: Operational screens fixed for this pilot, not literature-certified cutoffs or population confidence intervals; continuous results retained

controls.trim_control: same n removed randomly within each period; actual corpus unchanged
controls.gaussian_definition: Same unit-cloud mean/covariance in expectation, then row L2. Retain actual spread/PR mismatch. Descriptive reference, no calibrated p-values.

temporal.interpretation: Equal n across dates; retrospective selected fixed corpus. No historical causal convergence or population trend.

synthetic.result: Numerical invariances pass; scalar connectivity proxies fail generic fragmentation interpretation; keep them as a multiscale diagnostic only.

reporting: rank agreement between alternatives and encoders
descriptive two-way model/Field decomposition without IID model-pair tests
no 2D distances or clustering of plotted coordinates
stop: Complete bounded pilot, report limitations; no automatic new inference, corpus expansion or manuscript.
